title: Launcher self-update 1.0.8
summary: Fixed the launcher update loop: verified detached installer, legacy 1.0.6 bridge, and automatic silent replacement.
notes: Launcher 1.0.6 can now hand off safely to the 1.0.8 installer.
Installer size and SHA-256 are verified before execution.
Future updates run detached with /S --updated and survive launcher shutdown.
